questions.subject: General Aptitude
questions.question: A circuit outputs a digit in the form of $4$ bits. $0$ is represented by $0000, 1$ by $0001, \ldots, 9$ by $1001$. A combinational circuit is to be designed which takes these $4$ bits as input and outputs $1$ if the digit $\geq$ $5$, and $0$ otherwise. If only $\textsf{AND}, \textsf{OR}$ and $\textsf{NOT}$ gates may be used, what is the minimum number of gates required?

questions.title: GATE EC 2020 | GA Question: 6
questions.subject: General Aptitude
questions.question:
The atomic fetch-and-set $x, y$ instruction unconditionally sets the memory location $x$ to $1$ and fetches the old value of $x$ in $y$ without allowing any intervening access to the memory location $x$. Consider the following implementation of $P$ and $V$ functions on a binary semaphore $S$.

void P (binary_semaphore *s) { 
    unsigned y; 
    unsigned *x = &(s->value); 
    do { 
        fetch-and-set x, y; 
    } while (y); 
}

void V (binary_semaphore *s) { 
    S->value = 0; 
}

Which one of the following is true?
questions.rawQuestionHtml:
The atomic fetch-and-set $x, y$ instruction unconditionally sets the memory location $x$ to $1$ and fetches the old value of $x$ in $y$ without allowing any intervening access to the memory location $x$. Consider the following implementation of $P$ and $V$ functions on a binary semaphore $S$.

void P (binary_semaphore *s) { 
    unsigned y; 
    unsigned *x = &(s->value); 
    do { 
        fetch-and-set x, y; 
    } while (y); 
}

void V (binary_semaphore *s) { 
    S->value = 0; 
}

Which one of the following is true? 

  1. The implementation may not work if context switching is disabled in $P$ 
  2. Instead of using fetch-and –set, a pair of normal load/store can be used 
  3. The implementation of $V$ is wrong
  4. The code does not implement a binary semaphore

Instead of using fetch-and –set , a pair of normal load/store can be used

questions.title: GATE EC 2020 | GA Question: 10
questions.subject: General Aptitude
questions.question: Consider three processes, all arriving at time zero, with total execution time of $10$, $20$ and $30$ units, respectively. Each process spends the first $\text{20%}$ of execution time doing I/O, the next $\text{70%}$ of time doing computation, and the last $\text{10%}$ of time doing I/O again. The operating system uses a shortest remaining compute time first scheduling algorithm and schedules a new process either when the running process gets blocked on I/O or when the running process finishes its compute burst. Assume that all I/O operations can be overlapped as much as possible. For what percentage of time does the CPU remain idle?

questions.title: GATE EC 2020 | EC Question: 1
questions.subject: Control Systems
questions.question: The steady-state error $e_{ss}$ of a Type-1 unity feedback control system to a unit ramp input $r(t) = t \cdot u(t)$ is given by:
questions.explanation:
Step-by-Step Solution (Control Systems):

For a Type-1 system with unit ramp input: velocity error constant $K_v = \lim_{s \to 0} s G(s)$, and steady-state error $e_{ss} = \frac{1}{K_v}$.

questions.title: GATE EC 2020 | EC Question: 11
questions.subject: Electromagnetics & Antennas
questions.question: A lossless transmission line with characteristic impedance $Z_0 = 50\,\Omega$ is terminated in a load impedance $Z_L = 100\,\Omega$. The voltage reflection coefficient $\Gamma$ is:
questions.explanation:
Step-by-Step Solution (Electromagnetics & Antennas):

$\Gamma = \frac{Z_L - Z_0}{Z_L + Z_0} = \frac{100 - 50}{100 + 50} = \frac{50}{150} = +\frac{1}{3} = +0.333$.

questions.title: GATE EC 2020 | EC Question: 26
questions.subject: Electromagnetics & Antennas
questions.question: A uniform plane electromagnetic wave propagates in free space with permittivity $\epsilon_0$ and permeability $\mu_0$. The intrinsic wave impedance $\eta_0 = \sqrt{\mu_0 / \epsilon_0}$ (in Ohms) is closest to ________ (rounded off to nearest integer).
questions.explanation:
Step-by-Step Solution (Electromagnetics & Antennas):

$\eta_0 = \sqrt{\frac{4\pi \times 10^{-7}}{8.854 \times 10^{-12}}} \approx 120\pi \approx 376.99 \approx 377\,\Omega$.

questions.title: GATE EC 2020 | EC Question: 33
questions.subject: Signals & Systems
questions.question: The continuous-time signal $x(t) = \cos(200\pi t) + \sin(600\pi t)$ is sampled. According to Nyquist criterion, the minimum sampling frequency $f_s$ (Nyquist rate, in Hz) required to avoid aliasing is ________.
questions.explanation:
Step-by-Step Solution (Signals & Systems):

The maximum angular frequency is $\omega_{\text{max}} = 600\pi\text{ rad/s} \implies f_{\text{max}} = \frac{600\pi}{2\pi} = 300\text{ Hz}$. The Nyquist rate is $f_s = 2 f_{\text{max}} = 2 \times 300 = 600\text{ Hz}$.
